description: Wire contract for a Codex PermissionRequest command-hook decision. This repository requires every denial to include an actionable message that explains the approved alternative. A neutral hook emits no output and therefore does not use this schema.

message.description: Required for denial: bounded corrective guidance that states the policy reason and directs the agent to an approved alternative.

systemMessage.description: Optional warning surfaced in the UI or event stream.

title: Codex PermissionRequest command-hook output
